subject: Request: serving architecture deep-dive and on-prem constraints
messages:
From: Samir Lal <samir.lal@helion.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@helion.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Post-discovery: deep-dive on serving architecture and on-prem constraints

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the discovery session yesterday — that was helpful. Our infra and security teams went through the notes and want a technical deep-dive focused on production topology, networking constraints for an on-prem deployment, and performance expectations for mixed batch/interactive traffic.

High-level asks: 
- Walk us through the inference runtime (KV cache, batching behavior) and how it behaves with long-lived chat sessions.
- Options for private deployment: VPC peering vs. air-gapped on-prem package and what access we need to provide.
- Expected latency & throughput for the 100–500 rps profile (we can share load profile).
- What telemetry/audit artifacts we can expect for SOC-2 evidence.

Proposed attendees from Helion: myself (product), Priya (platform lead), Tomas (DBA) — Icc'd Tomas on internal calendar invite.

Can you propose two 60–75 minute slots next week (we're GMT+1) — preferably one early morning for us (08:00–10:00 CEST) to include APAC engineers if possible. Also, can you include any pre-read or checklist we should complete beforehand?

Thanks,
Samir
--
Samir Lal
Director of Product
Helion AI
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Lal <samir.lal@helion.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@helion.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:48:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: deep-dive on serving architecture and on-prem constraints

Samir — great to hear the discovery was useful. We'd be happy to run a focused technical deep-dive. 

Proposed agenda (60–75m):
1) 5m — goals & scope (you + Neha)
2) 20m — runtime internals: batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs (Ben)
3) 20m — deployment modes: hosted vs. dedicated vs. private (VPC/air-gap) (Neha)
4) 10m — telemetry, audit logs, SOC-2 evidence and retention (Marissa)
5) 10–20m — Q&A and next steps / mutual action plan

Suggested slots (CEST):
- Option A: Thu 23 Jul, 08:30–09:45 CEST
- Option B: Fri 24 Jul, 07:00–08:15 CEST (we can make this early APAC-friendly)

Pre-reads / checklist I can share: short checklist (network blocks we need to open, sample load profile, and a pointer to our SOC-2 evidence pack). Attaching a concise pre-demo checklist to this thread. Please review and, if possible, upload your topology diagram before the call.

Attaching: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (stub)

Ben will lead the runtime section and Marissa will cover telemetry/audit. Ben/Marissa — can you confirm coverage of the two agenda items? Also, any constraints on making Option A vs Option B (timezone stretch)?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Lal <samir.lal@helion.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: deep-dive on serving architecture and on-prem constraints

Neha — confirmed, I can take the runtime section. A couple of notes I want to surface so Helion can prep if helpful: 
- If you can provide a short sample trace for a 1–2 minute interactive session, we'll use it to show KV-hit behavior and end-to-end latency in the demo.
- For the mixed rps profile, please indicate the percent of concurrent long-lived chats vs short requests — that changes batching strategy.
- I'll prepare a short slide on quantization impact on latency vs. model-size; if Tomas (DBA) can join to talk about storage/IO constraints that would be useful.

Option A (Thu 23 Jul 08:30 CEST) works for me and Marissa has tentatively confirmed. If you prefer Option B for APAC attendance, I can make it too but would prefer Option A for better overlap with our EU infra leads.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
